title: Design System: Noah Austin — Personal Site

display.purpose: Schibsted Grotesk 900. The hero name, once, followed by the drawing cobalt arrow.

title.purpose: Schibsted Grotesk 700. Activity / distinction entry titles.

notation.purpose: Spline Sans Mono uppercase — the debater's shorthand hand: margin labels, marks, years, nav, links.

motion.name: ease-out-flow
motion.purpose: Standard ease for reveals, line draws, and state transitions.

motion.name: draw-line-y
motion.purpose: The cobalt flow line drawing down each section's left edge on scroll.

motion.name: slide-in-left
motion.purpose: Timeline entries sliding in from the flow line.

components.name: Flow Link
components.description: The primary action affordance — a mono text link that sweeps a cobalt underline on hover/focus. No filled buttons exist.
components.css: .ds-flow-link { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #16181d; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 5px; transition: color 0.2s ease, text-decoration-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-flow-link:hover, .ds-flow-link:focus-visible { color: #1e3ad6; text-decoration-color: #1e3ad6; outline: none; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: The hero name in the heaviest grotesk weight, once per page, followed by the drawing cobalt argument-arrow.
components.css: .ds-masthead { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: clamp(3.75rem, 8vw, 6rem); line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #16181d; margin: 0; } .ds-arrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin-top: 1.5rem; } .ds-arrow-line { display: block; height: 1px; width: 8rem; background: #1e3ad6; } .ds-arrow-head { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #1e3ad6; }

components.name: Flow Label
components.description: The signature notation margin — a cobalt mark whose glyph encodes the section's role (∴ claim, — set, → tested, ✓ extended) plus a mono label.
components.css: .ds-flow-label { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #565f6b; margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-mark { font-size: 1rem; color: #1e3ad6; }

components.name: Section Title
components.description: Section headline in heavy grotesk at the top of the argument column.
components.css: .ds-section-title { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 4vw, 2.25rem); line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #16181d; margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Top-nav item — mono uppercase; active state prefixed with a cobalt →, no pill or fill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; } .ds-nav-item { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #565f6b; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #16181d; } .ds-nav-active { color: #16181d; } .ds-nav-tick { color: #1e3ad6; }

components.name: Timeline Entry
components.description: A ledger entry on the Activities timeline — cobalt mono year, heavy grotesk title, graphite description, separated by a hairline rule (never a card).
components.html:

components.css: .ds-entry { border-top: 1px solid #d7dad1; padding: 2rem 0; max-width: 65ch; } .ds-entry-year { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #1e3ad6; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-entry-title { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #16181d; margin: 0; } .ds-entry-desc { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #565f6b; margin: 0.75rem 0 0; }

narrative.overview: A competitive debater keeps a 'flow' — the shorthand sheet that tracks an argument's life across a round: a claim is made, a response answers it, a rebuttal extends or drops it, connectors show where ideas clash. This site is built as one long flow. A cobalt line draws down the left edge of each section as you scroll — the argument advancing. The left margin carries debate notation that means something (∴ the claim, — an open thread, → where it's tested, ✓ extended), not decorative numbering. Type is one confident grotesk in heavy weight/size contrast plus a humanist mono used exactly as a debater's shorthand. Color commits: near-black ink on a cool sheet, cobalt as the argument line, clash-red held in reserve. It is a deliberate move off the editorial-typographic lane the previous version had drifted into — no Fraunces, no Newsreader, no reflex-serif restraint.
keyCharacteristics: A two-column flow: notation margin + argument column, with a cobalt flow line drawing down each section.
Notation carries meaning (∴ — → ✓); numbering only where order is real (the Activities timeline).
One committed accent — cobalt — used generously as the 'argument line'; clash-red is rare.
One heavy grotesk (Schibsted Grotesk) in weight/size contrast + one humanist mono (Spline Sans Mono) as debate shorthand.
Hairline rules instead of cards. No box-shadows, no gradients, near-zero radius.

rules.name: The Argument-Line Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the flow of the argument, so it may run generously (lines, marks, years, links) — but only ever as ink, never as a filled button or background panel. It marks the reasoning; it doesn't upholster the page.

rules.name: The Two-Pen Rule
rules.body: Clash-red is the second pen and stays rare. It appears only where something is genuinely being contested or dropped. Reaching for it as a general accent is prohibited — that is what cobalt is for.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Contrast is built from Schibsted Grotesk's own weight range (400 → 900), not a second proportional typeface. A serif never enters this system.

rules.name: The Shorthand Rule
rules.body: Mono means notation. If text is set in Spline Sans Mono it must be a label, a year, a mark, a nav item, or a link — never running prose.

rules.name: The Paper-Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. To separate content, use a hairline rule, whitespace, or the cobalt flow line — never a shadow or a card.

dos: Do keep the notation margin + argument column, and let the cobalt flow line draw down each section (static under reduced motion).
Do make every margin mark mean something (∴ — → ✓); use ordered numbering only where order is real, like the Activities timeline.
Do run cobalt (#1e3ad6) generously as ink — lines, marks, years, links — and keep clash-red (#c8362a) rare.
Do build hierarchy from Schibsted Grotesk's weight range; confine Spline Sans Mono to notation, labels, years, nav, and links.
Do cap body measure ~65–75ch, use text-wrap balance on headings / pretty on prose, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep reading copy ≥16px so Graphite on Sheet clears 4.5:1.
donts: Don't reintroduce the editorial-typographic lane: no display serif (Fraunces / Newsreader / Playfair / Cormorant), no italic-serif headlines, no mono-label-over-monochrome restraint.
Don't ship generic AI slop: no dark-bg + neon accent, no glassmorphism, no gradient text, no decorative 01/02/03 numbering, no animated counters.
Don't drift into corporate SaaS: no hero metric, no feature-card grids, no filled CTA buttons.
Don't use cards, side-stripe borders, or any box-shadow — surfaces stay flat; separate with rules, whitespace, or the flow line.
Don't set running prose in the mono, or turn cobalt into a filled button/background.
Don't let clash-red spread into a general accent — it means 'clash / dropped,' nothing else.
